meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建带时间轴的可渲染动画或视频项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把分镜或脚本规整成带片段和轨道的可渲染媒体项目
copy.tagline_en: Build a renderable animated or video project with structured clips and tracks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn your storyboard or script into a renderable media project with tracks and clips

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 的组合契约,产出一份能渲染成视频的 HTML:用 data-* 属性声明时间、注册一条可拖动的暂停时间线、把音视频播放交给框架,并遵守确定性渲染规则。
howto.when: 在写 composition HTML 之前接管:涉及组合结构、data-* 时间属性等渲染契约,或要处理 Tailwind 项目与 STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md 计划文件时。

say.text: 帮我用 HyperFrames 写一个最小的可渲染 composition。
say.note: 会给出骨架并做 lint 检查。

say.text: 运行 hyperframes check 并解释这些 lint 报错。
say.note: 会跑校验并说明每条报错的成因。

howto.what_en: Claude builds a renderable HyperFrames HTML video: it declares timing with data-* attributes, registers one paused seekable timeline, lets the framework own media playback, and follows deterministic-render rules.
howto.when_en: It takes over before you write composition HTML — for composition structure, data-* timing attributes and the render contract, or Tailwind projects and plan files.

say_en.text: Write me the smallest renderable HyperFrames composition.
say_en.note: Gives a skeleton and lint-checks it.

say_en.text: How should I set data-start and data-duration here?
Run hyperframes check and explain the lint errors.
